title: More natural running
changes: Heroes and monsters with a sword, axe, dagger, hammer or mace keep it gripped while they run. It swings with the arm instead of dangling at the hip, and spear carriers run with the point held forward.
A shield is held close at the side while running, the same way it is carried at a walk, instead of stuck out in front.
The vampire's Wolf Form now really gallops: the paws land one after another and push off, and the body rises and falls gently instead of bouncing.
